blocks.text: Brentwood Park homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Brentwood Park, September 2026. Detached houses: 21 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 360 listed at month end and 39 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 11 sold over 4 months against an average of 19.2 listed, about 7.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 4 sold. Condos and townhomes: 198 sold over 4 months against an average of 349.8 listed, about 7.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 57 sold.
